findings.explanation: Two separate invoice scans (INV-1003-A and INV-1003-B) were received for the identical supplier invoice number SSS/2026/188, same date 2026-07-16 and same amount of 70,800 INR, with no cancellation or explanatory note resolving the duplication, though only one payment (BNK-1003) and one ledger entry (LED-1003) exist so no double payment occurred.
